name: Strand7 Student Version
summary: Full Strand7 finite element analysis software for engineering students for coursework, at a low monthly fee.
key: Student access to Strand7 costs AU$10 per month, plus GST (if applicable).
who: Students enrolled in an approved university course, confirmed by a lecturer.
how: Email the Student Version Application Form to student@strand7.com. Access usually arrives within 1 to 3 business days.
catches: Coursework only, one computer at a time, internet connection required, no technical support. All modules except the API.
